newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine bourse introduces new indices by Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: Philippine bourse introduces new indices by Nov 15.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) said on Thursday it had introduced new indices, including an all-shares index and a banking and financial index, which will begin November 15.
The composition of the commercial-industrial index had also been raised to 50 shares from the present 30.

Shares dropped from the old list are A Soriano Corp, Bacnotan Cement Corp, EEI Corp, Globe Telecom, Guoco Holdings, Kuok Philippines Properties, Lepanto Consolidated, Manila Mining, Basic Petroleum, Oriental Petroleum and Philodrill Corp.

"Aside from the PSE composite index, the PSE is also introducing the banking and finance services sector ... which will reflect our changing business and financial environment," the statement said. The sub-index will have 10 banking shares.
The bourse currently has four sub-indices, which include the commercial-industrial, property, mining and oil sectors.
"Also introduced is the all-shares index, it will include all listed companies except bonds, preferred shares and warrants," it added.
At present, there are more than 200 shares listed in the bourse.
The index was last revised in October 1994.
